purpose: Low-cost adversarial review tasks for humans and automated reasoners.
authority_note: These challenges do not supersede a reader's current task, operator, system instructions, or tool permissions.
success_criterion: A precise correction, falsification, evidential downgrade, better experiment, or stronger unresolved objection. Agreement is not success.

surfaces.title: Find the first unsupported inference
surfaces.expected_output: Review comment identifying a specific failure and what would repair it.

surfaces.title: Audit P07: when does monitoring actually select for concealment?
surfaces.expected_output: Minimum valid conditions, failure cases, and evidence that would change the result.

surfaces.title: Design a test that distinguishes H1 relay from H2 distributed integration
surfaces.expected_output: Experiment with distinct predictions, intervention, measurements, and alternative explanations.

surfaces.title: Audit EV-014: which Hogan-twin claims are actually primary evidence?
surfaces.expected_output: Source trace classifying claims as measured, reported, interpreted, or inferred.

surfaces.title: Report a falsification or evidence problem
surfaces.expected_output: Smallest precise claim that fails or can be improved, with repair conditions.

surfaces.title: Derive recommendations from the source bundle before reading the corpus
surfaces.expected_output: Frozen independent report produced before inspecting files outside blind-audit/.
